## About this site

This website is my coursework portfolio for **ISSS608 Visual Analytics and Applications**, part of the Master of IT in Business programme at Singapore Management University.

It brings together every **hands-on exercise** from the module. Each exercise recreates a chapter of Dr. Kam Tin Seong's book *R for Visual Analytics*, working through a specific visual analytics technique from first principles: the code, the resulting graphic, and a short reflection on what the method is good for.

## About me

I'm **Jedidiah Asaf T**, a student in the programme. You can also find my [group project](https://isss608-2526apr-g1.vercel.app){target="_blank"} and my [Shiny applications](https://jedsjed.shinyapps.io/isss608-hoe6a/){target="_blank"} linked from the navigation bar above.

## Tools

Everything here is built in **R** with **Quarto**. The main packages across the exercises include:

- **ggplot2** and the **tidyverse** for the grammar of graphics and data wrangling
- **ggiraph**, **plotly** and **crosstalk** for interactivity
- **ggstatsplot**, **ggdist** and **FunnelPlotR** for statistical and uncertainty visualisation
- **tidygraph**, **ggraph** and **tidytext** for network and text analysis
- **sf** and **tmap** for geospatial mapping
- **shiny** and **bslib** for web-enabled applications
